opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with guests and filters
opportunities.description: Search Kayak Stays for a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} with {rooms}/{adults}/{children}, then apply {filters} and {sort_order}.
steps: Open Kayak and click Stays in the left menu
Type the destination and pick the matching suggestion
Open the date picker and choose the check-in and check-out dates
Open the guests dropdown and set rooms, adults, children (and child ages)
Click the search button
On results apply filters (hotel class, review score, amenities, style)
Open 'Sorted by' and choose the sort order (e.g., Price low to high)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27–Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults; sort Price low to high
Santa Fe, NM; Jun 16–Jun 18; 2 rooms, 3 adults
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6–Jun 10; 2 rooms, 3 adults + 1 child age 7; review 8+, 3-star, free internet, Family style, air-conditioned; sort Price low to high
Los Angeles, CA; May 21–May 23; 1 room, 2 adults; 5-star filter

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways partner hotel search (Booking.com)
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways Book > Hotels, search the Booking.com partner site for {destination}, {dates}, {adults}/{rooms}, then sort/filter and open a hotel.
steps: On qatarairways.com click Book in the top nav
Click Hotels under Plan your trip
On the Booking.com partner page, type the destination and pick the suggestion
Pick check-in and check-out dates
Set adults, children and rooms
Click Search
Apply sort or filters (price lowest first, neighbourhood, star rating, facilities)
Click See availability on a chosen hotel and Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; Apr 10–Apr 16; 2 adults, 1 room; sort Price (lowest first)
Washington DC; Jun 5–Jun 6; 4 adults, 2 rooms; Downtown DC, 5 stars, Free WiFi; St. Regis Reserve

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways one-way flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Qatar Airways, search a one-way flight from {origin} to {destination} on {date} with {adults}/{children}/{infants} in {cabin_class}, then pick a fare.
steps: Open the Book widget (Flights or Qatar Stopover tab)
Enter the From airport and pick the suggestion
Enter the To airport and pick the suggestion
Set trip type to One way
Open Depart, pick the date, click Continue
Open Passengers/Class, set adults/children/infants and cabin class, click Confirm
Click Show flights
Choose a flight's cabin price box, then Select fare (repeat for any further legs)

instances.values: Qatar Stopover; Colombo CMB → New York JFK; one way 24 Jun 23; 2 adults + 1 child; Premium (Business); Business Comfort
Through Explore > Africa > Durban page; Doha DOH → Durban DUR; one way 28 May 23; 2 adults + 1 infant; Economy; Economy Comfort
